answer: A bond of 56% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in mesa, and mirror reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 25 aliases, and each one needs its own funded saffron account. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 10 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
